sharepoint:list-item-create.doc:name: Create Job Log Item
sharepoint:list-item-create.sharepoint:properties: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var processedFiles = vars.processedFiles default [] var errorDetails = vars.errorDetails default [] var processedCount = sizeOf(processedFiles) var errorCount = sizeOf(errorDetails) var computedStatus = if (errorCount == 0) 'Success' else if (processedCount > 0) 'Partial Success' else 'Failed' var status = vars.libraryStatus default computedStatus var detailsText = if (vars.libraryStatus == 'Failed' and vars.libraryFailureReason != null) 'Library-level failure: ' ++ (vars.libraryFailureReason as String) else ( (if (processedCount > 0) ['Processed: ' ++ (processedFiles joinBy ', ')] else []) ++ (if (errorCount > 0) ['Errors: ' ++ (errorDetails joinBy '; ')] else []) ) joinBy '\n' --- { Title: vars.documentLibrary ++ '_' ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}), ExecutionTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}, SourceFolder: vars.documentLibrary as String, ExecutionType: vars.executionType default 'Manual', FilesProcessed: processedCount as String, ErrorCount: errorCount as String, Status: status, Details: if (isEmpty(detailsText)) 'No files found' else detailsText }]

logger.doc:name: Log Job Log Write Failure
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var status = "warning" var msg = "IDP Job Log - WARNING: Could not write job log entry to SharePoint list for library: " ++ (vars.documentLibrary default 'unknown') --- CustomLogMapper::logger({ correlationId: correlationId, app: app, mule: mule, status: status, message: msg, (payload: {documentLibrary: vars.documentLibrary, errorType: error.errorType.identifier, errorDescription: error.description}) if (p('log.level') == "DEBUG"), env: p('mule.env') })]
